gate.title: Locked point-guided T1/T2/FLAIR MRI frontend

automated_checks.description: Run the CPU synthetic point-guided suite, including the frontend smoke and refusal to synthesize T1ce.
Compile the point-guided frontend and its focused tests.
Reject whitespace errors in the working-tree diff.

human_gate.policy: Automated checks collect software evidence only. This runner cannot approve the Human Gate; a human must review the locked boundary and record any decision outside this runner.
questions: Does the implementation preserve the T1/T2/FLAIR input, RAS-mm coordinates, explicit spacing, deterministic points, bounded 2 mm displacement, fixed 4 mm supports, and compact semantic-aware PoU contracts?
Does the public boundary stop at coarse semantics, points, point-centre semantics, and sparse PoU without creating a T1ce volume or adding unresolved downstream behavior?

non_claims: A passing automated gate is software-contract evidence only, not reconstruction, clinical, or novelty validation.
This frontend does not synthesize, reconstruct, export, or claim a T1ce volume.
Spectral anchors, dynamic tri-planes, selection, updates, history, stopping, decoding, and reconstruction losses remain unresolved interfaces.
